name: nomos-governed-x402-hedera
description: NOMOS Governed x402 on Hedera — From Proof of Payment to Proof of Action
x-runtime-note: This package has ZERO dependencies on purpose. Everything in CP-H0/CP-H1 runs
on Node's built-ins: `node:crypto` for Ed25519 and SHA-256, `node:test` for the
test runner, and Node's native TypeScript type-stripping so there is no build
step. That keeps the offline governance core auditable line-by-line and means a
reviewer can clone and run `npm test` with no install and no network.
CP-H2 adds exactly one runtime dependency family: @x402/hedera (and its
@hiero-ledger/sdk peer) for the real Hedera payment path.
